title: Chapter III
chineseTitle: 第 3 章：小王子的星球

paragraphs.en: The little prince, who asked many questions but rarely answered mine, gradually revealed his origins through chance conversations.
paragraphs.zh: 这个经常提问却很少回答我问题的小王子，逐渐在偶然的交谈中透露出了他的身世。

paragraphs.en: One day, when he saw my airplane, he inquired: "What is that object?" I replied, "It's an airplane, and it flies. It's my airplane."
paragraphs.zh: 有一天，他看到我的飞机后问道：“那是什么东西？”我回答说：“那是一架飞机，会飞的。这是我的飞机。”

paragraphs.en: Proud of this revelation, I felt slighted by his laughter at the idea that I had come from the sky.
paragraphs.zh: 我为这个发现感到自豪，却对他笑我对天空而来的说法时的轻蔑感到了一丝不快。

paragraphs.en: He then asked, "So you're also from the sky? Which planet are you from?" This question sparked a momentary curiosity in him, but he quickly changed the subject to his sheep.
paragraphs.zh: 他接着问道：“这么说你也是从天上来的？你是哪个星球的？”这个问题让他短暂地产生了好奇，但很快他就把话题转到了他的羊身上。

paragraphs.en: My curiosity piqued, I pressed further: "Where do you come from? What is this 'where I live' you speak of? Where will you take your sheep?"
paragraphs.zh: 我好奇心大增，继续追问：“你从哪里来？你说的‘我的家园’是指哪里？你要把羊带到哪儿去？”

paragraphs.en: He responded with a thoughtful pause before saying, "The box you gave me is perfect for him at night." He then suggested we could provide a string and post during the day to keep his sheep secure.
paragraphs.zh: 他沉思了一下，然后说道：“你给我的那个盒子正好适合他在晚上使用。”接着建议我们白天可以给他提供一根绳子和一个羊圈，以确保羊群的安全。

paragraphs.en: However, the little prince was appalled by this idea. "Tie him! What a strange notion!"
paragraphs.zh: 然而，小王子对这个想法感到震惊。“把他绑起来！真是个奇怪的想法！”他脱口而出。

paragraphs.en: he exclaimed. I explained that without restraint, the sheep might wander off and get lost. But he insisted, "Anywhere straight ahead of him, nobody can go far."
paragraphs.zh: 他脱口而出：“我解释说，如果不加约束，羊可能会走失。但他坚持认为：‘在他前方的任何直路上，没人能走得远。’”

paragraphs.en: With a hint of sadness, he added, "Everything is so small where I live."
paragraphs.zh: 他带着一丝悲伤说道：“我住的地方一切都那么渺小。”
